title: Design: Over Credit confirmation looks as it does today
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A Net 45 customer is over its credit limit, and you compare the Over Credit question with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Customer-A} is on Net 45 with a credit limit of {Amount-A} and a balance above it.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-25 Over, {Amount-A} is $500.00 and the balance is $600.00.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p8-01-the-over-credit-warning-today.png, ct-p8-03-still-warns-limit-above-0-exceeded.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the customer page of {Customer-A}.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Work Order".
  2. Click "Save".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Work Order" window opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Confirmation" opens over it with the message "Are you sure you want to open a new work order? This customer is over their credit limit." and the buttons "Create" (red) then "Cancel", looking exactly as today's picture ct-p8-01-the-over-credit-warning-today.png (Cancel blue filled, blue ×).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

The board's redraw (ct-p8-03) shows a white Cancel; the PRD says the dialog is unchanged, so compare with today's picture (register CT-D06, settled).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-R1: “When a user opens a new work order for a customer whose balance exceeds a credit limit above $0, and the customer is not on COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold, the existing confirmation shows unchanged: title "Confirmation", message "Are you sure you want to open a new work order? This customer is over their credit limit.", buttons "Create" and "Cancel".”
  • S9-R3: “Wording and buttons are unchanged.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Over credit limit on New Work Order (unchanged wording) | "Are you sure you want to open a new work order? This customer is over their credit limit." | Confirmation titled "Confirmation", buttons "Create" and "Cancel"”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "8 Over Credit warning" ("The Over Credit warning today", "Still warns: limit above $0 exceeded"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.
